episodes.title: Is the Jehovah's Witness religion about to collapse?
episodes.description:
7. Despite recording a small increase in members during 2026, what do the figures really show for the JWs?  I take a look at how the organization is growing in a small number of countries but stagnating and declining in others.

When JW leaders and elders tell you that your contributed money, gifted wills & trusts, stocks & shares and donations of real estate all gets spent on building Kingdom Halls why not ask them why record numbers of Halls in Europe and the USA  have been shut down and sold during the past 10 years.

episodes.title: Jehovah's Witnesses changes in 2027? 10 possibilities (ranked from 'likely' to 'not a chance!')
episodes.description:
4. In the ever-changing world of Jehovahs Witnesses with U-turns on doctrine a regular occurrence I group 10 possible changes for 2027 into the 'likely' 'possible' and 'not a chance' categories.

Will 'new light' become 'old light' or will the old new light be brought back as 'new light' or will everyone get confused and forget they're in a cult?  Could some of the changes be overlapping changes...?

Let me know in the comments what potential changes you think we could see in 2027.

Please note that all of the following are POTENTIAL changes that could happen.  The Governing Body (or perhaps more accurately their accountants and lawyers) may have other changes in mind for 2027...

episodes.title: The exhausting schedule that burns out Jehovahs Witnesses
episodes.description:
3. What activities is a Jehovahs Witness pressured to do to remain active and not raise the suspicions of the elders of the religion? As an exJW that spent 33 years in the cult I ponder whether there are enough hours in the day for a JW to fulfill their commitments.

Despite the JW leadership effectively 'giving back' one evening per week to its members with a change to the bookstudy arrangement in 2009 they instructed JWs to use that evening as a 'family study evening'. This was an arrangement where the JW 'head of the household' spent some time indoctrinating family members in JW cult doctrine.
